note: Public crypto enforcement cases. Amounts as published by the authority; amount null = not yet confirmed from the decision. verify: true = the decision itself is still to be linked.
queue: NL: read the DNB decision PDFs for the exact Wwft articles of each case (Binance and Kraken: art. 23b(1)(2) and 23c(3), from the decision)
NL: the Rotterdam court rulings on these decisions (ECLI) and the Knaken bankruptcy ruling
AFM: MiCAR enforcement after 30 June 2025 (warnings, orders, fines) and ESMA's register of non-compliant entities
EU national supervisors (BaFin, AMF, CONSOB, CNMV ...)

cases.title: DNB: fine Binance Holdings Ltd., crypto services without registration
cases.summary: Crypto services in the Netherlands without the DNB registration the Wwft required, from 21 May 2020 to at least 1 December 2021. Objection filed 2 June 2022 and withdrawn 27 July 2022; the fine is final.

cases.title: DNB: fine Coinbase Europe Limited, crypto services without registration
cases.summary: Crypto services in the Netherlands from November 2020 without the DNB registration the Wwft then required; registered 22 September 2022.

cases.measure: order subject to penalty (last onder dwangsom)
cases.amount_note: EUR 500,000 per week, maximum EUR 4 million; DNB states the full eight weeks passed
cases.title: DNB: last onder dwangsom Payward International Markets Limited (Kraken), crypto services without registration
cases.summary: Ordered to stop offering crypto services in or from the Netherlands without DNB registration. Objection filed 4 August 2023, declared unfounded 21 December 2023.

cases.amount_note: EUR 2,850,000 imposed; reduced to EUR 2,277,500 by the Rotterdam district court on 19 December 2025
cases.title: DNB: fine for an unnamed crypto service provider, crypto services without registration
cases.summary: Crypto services in the Netherlands without DNB registration; the party is not named by DNB. The court reduced the fine.

cases.measure: order subject to penalty (last onder dwangsom)
cases.amount_note: EUR 500,000 per week after 30 September 2024, maximum EUR 4 million; DNB states the full eight weeks passed
cases.title: DNB: last onder dwangsom Peken Global Limited (KuCoin), crypto services without registration
cases.summary: Ordered to stop offering crypto services in or from the Netherlands without DNB registration. No objection; the order is irrevocable.

cases.title: DNB: fine Bybit Fintech Limited, crypto services without registration until September 2023
cases.summary: Crypto services in the Netherlands without DNB registration until September 2023. DNB reduced the fine because Bybit ended the violation, including moving its Dutch clients to a local partner.

cases.title: DNB: fine Aux Cayes Fintech Co. Ltd. (OKX), crypto services without registration July 2023 to August 2024
cases.summary: Crypto services in the Netherlands without DNB registration from July 2023 to August 2024.

cases.title: AFM: warning against crypto platform MEXC Global, crypto-asset services without a MiCAR licence
cases.summary: The AFM warns that MEXC Global offers crypto-asset services in the Netherlands without the required MiCAR licence; listed in ESMA's register of non-compliant entities.

cases.measure: bankruptcy petition in the public interest
cases.party: Knaken Cryptohandel B.V. and Stichting Knaken Payments
cases.title: OM: bankruptcy petition for crypto company Knaken, no AFM licence
cases.summary: Knaken offered exchange and custody of crypto without the required AFM licence and stopped paying out clients; the OM asked the Rotterdam court to declare it bankrupt, after signals from the AFM. FIOD investigation runs separately.

cases.title: DOJ: Binance and CEO plead guilty, over USD 4 billion
cases.summary: Failure to maintain an effective AML program, unlicensed money transmitting and sanctions violations.
cases.chain: transactions between US users and users in sanctioned jurisdictions; illicit proceeds (ransomware, darknet, scams) through the exchange

cases.title: DOJ SDNY: OKX pleads guilty to unlicensed money transmitting
cases.summary: Operated an unlicensed money transmitting business serving US customers without FinCEN registration and AML compliance.
cases.chain: over USD 5 billion of suspicious transactions and criminal proceeds (per DOJ)

cases.title: DOJ SDNY: KuCoin pleads guilty to unlicensed money transmitting
cases.summary: Unlicensed money transmitting; no effective KYC/AML program, no suspicious activity reports.
cases.chain: suspicious and criminal funds (darknet, malware, ransomware, fraud) through the exchange

cases.amount_note: OFAC USD 24,280,829.20; FinCEN USD 29,280,829.20 with the OFAC amount credited
cases.title: OFAC: settlement with Bittrex for apparent sanctions violations
cases.summary: 116,421 apparent violations of sanctions programs (Crimea region of Ukraine, Cuba, Iran, Sudan, Syria); willful BSA AML and SAR violations (FinCEN).
cases.chain: users with an IP or physical address in sanctioned jurisdictions

cases.party: Terraform Labs PTE Ltd. and Do Kwon
cases.title: SEC: Terraform and Kwon to pay over USD 4.5 billion
cases.summary: Fraud involving crypto asset securities; registration violations.

cases.title: FinCEN: Bitzlato a primary money laundering concern (section 9714)
cases.summary: Transmittals of funds involving Bitzlato prohibited for covered financial institutions from 1 February 2023.
cases.chain: funds from Russian ransomware groups and darknet markets

cases.amount_note: funds frozen; amount to confirm from the DOJ release
cases.title: DOJ: Garantex disrupted in an international operation
cases.summary: Domains seized, servers taken down with Germany and Finland; administrators charged.
cases.chain: exchange allegedly used to launder proceeds of crime
